item.title: iPhone 18 Base Rumors: Bigger Battery, Higher Price
item.description: Leak suggests the iPhone 18 base will outprice the iPhone 17, adding a larger battery and Apple’s first 2‑nm A20 chip, while dropping Dynamic Island.

item.title: iPhone 18e Rumor: 9 GB RAM Marks New Low‑End Boost
item.description: Analyst Jeff Pu says Apple’s upcoming iPhone 18e, slated for March 2027, will boost low‑end memory to 9 GB, up from the 8 GB in the iPhone 17e.
